name: spritemake-sprite-intake
purpose: Capture a short natural-language sprite request, infer a timestamped output batch folder, create SpriteMake markdown scaffolding, write PROMPT.md, and support keyless Codex direct generation without storing API keys.
note: This documents the desired prompt-time behavior for SpriteMake agents. Codex must follow AGENTS.md or call this hook; this file alone does not make the Codex runtime execute hooks automatically.
